reason: With the wedding coming and relatives visiting, I do need the house repainted, but I'll just call our family painter like we always do. He knows the house and I trust whatever paint he picks, so I don't see why I'd hand it to a brand and crew I've never heard of.
objection: I have not heard much about Turbolux. Is it really as good as Asian Paints or the other big names? If it bubbles or fades before the wedding photos, the family will blame me, and a guarantee doesn't fix that.
would_change_my_mind: If our family painter himself told me Turbolux paint is as good as the big brands and he'd be happy to use it, or if I could see a Kochi home they painted a year ago that still looks good after a monsoon.
